verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists enterprise-style deployment options: running LightSprint in your own infrastructure or private cloud, routing model traffic through an approved gateway, and controlling sandbox egress. Access roles map to existing GitHub org permissions, which supports organization-wide rollout. However, nothing mentions SSO/SAML or commercial support terms, and no explicit enterprise license tier is described. Missing for 10: explicit SSO/SAML support, a commercial support offering or SLA, a clearly defined enterprise license tier, and independent corroboration.
